definitions.full: H4589. maor [ מָעוֺר ] noun [masculine] nakedness, pudendum ; — only plural suffix מְעוֺרֵיהֶם Hab 2:15 .

occurrences.englishText: “Woe to him who gives his neighbor drink, pouring your inflaming wine until they are drunk, so that you may gaze at their naked bodies!
